title: Safer draft dismissal and clipboard sharing
summary: Escape respects nested color popups, and Share to Clipboard now copies the complete rendered image.

Fixed: Escape in a Text or Callout color popup closes only that popup. The enclosing text edit and its draft survive; a second Escape can cancel the edit.
Share > Clipboard is connected to the same full-image copy function as the toolbar and Edit menu. Copying preserves the document and Undo history.
Verified: Real egui key-event regression and native first/second Escape checks cover draft preservation and cancellation.
ClipCraft's Share menu clipboard output matches all 256000 fixture pixels. Snagit Share > Clipboard imports through ClipCraft with all 576000 opaque synthetic pixels unchanged.
Improved: Refreshed direct Share/View reference observations and expanded the detailed UI audit to 148 controls across 12 recorded surfaces.
Provisional target labels now reflect the next unfinished scopes. Published features and partial capabilities remain distinct.

limitations: Full interface parity remains incomplete: 36 recorded surfaces still need detailed mapping, and additional surfaces remain unobserved.
Screen capture, global hotkeys, rich text and external sharing destinations remain unfinished.
Clipboard interoperability now covers one opaque PNG from the reference app. Transparency, other external formats and Save-and-continue still need verification.
Other color-picker interactions and minimum-size layout remain under review. Native ClipCraft Save As inspection remains a separate blocker.
